locations.name: Stock 305
locations.description: A streetwear store in Stockyard with exclusive looks for Jason and Lucia. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

locations.name: Sara's Unisex Salon
locations.description: A salon with signature styles for Jason and Lucia, including facial hair, makeup and nails. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

locations.name: Electric Fang Tattoo
locations.description: A tattoo parlor in Stockyard with over 50 signature tattoos by the artist collective FAILE. Only open with the Ultimate Edition.

locations.name: Jason's House
locations.description: Jason's stilt house in Key Lento, lent to him by Brian. Jason and Lucia's first safehouse, in Chapter 1, until it goes up in flames in Home Sweet Home.

locations.name: Bayside Apartments, 201
locations.description: Boobie's apartment in Bayside, near the Jack of Hearts. He lets Jason and Lucia stay in it from Welcome to Vice City (Chapter 3) until Valentina moves them out in Chapter 4.

locations.name: Starlet Motel
locations.description: Jason and Lucia's motel room in Port Gellhorn, Kelly County: their safehouse in Chapter 2, until Checking Out moves them to Vice City for good.

locations.name: Hank's Waffles
locations.description: A waffle diner that Jason and Lucia rob in Rockstar's Extended Look gameplay reveal, where the robbery is shown as a flashback.

locations.name: Brian's Boat Works & Marina
locations.description: The boat yard of Brian Heder and his wife Lori in the Leonida Keys. Rockstar describes Brian as a classic drug runner who still moves product through it.

locations.name: Fleeca Field
locations.description: A sports stadium in Rockridge, Vice City, based on LoanDepot Park in Miami.

locations.name: Gellhorn International Raceway
locations.description: A race track near Port Gellhorn. It appears to draw on the real Sebring International Raceway.

locations.name: Lake Leonida
locations.description: The large lake in the middle of Leonida, next to Ambrosia. It is the game's version of Lake Okeechobee.

locations.name: Leonida Penitentiary
locations.description: The prison where Lucia served time before the story begins.

locations.name: Ocean View Hotel
locations.description: The iconic hotel from GTA Vice City returns, on Shore Drive, Ocean Beach.

locations.name: Mount Kalaga National Park
locations.description: A national park on Leonida's northern border, with hunting, fishing and off-road trails. Its canyon appears to be inspired by Providence Canyon in Georgia.

locations.name: Port Vice City
locations.description: The port of Vice City, which Rockstar calls the cruise ship capital of the world. It is based on PortMiami.

locations.name: Sahara Arena
locations.description: An indoor arena on the Downtown Vice City waterfront, home of the Vice City Narcos. It is the game's version of Miami's Kaseya Center.

locations.name: Vice City International Airport
locations.description: The airport of Vice City, modeled after Miami International Airport.

locations.name: Megamundo Building
locations.description: A skyscraper in Downtown Vice City, home of the Megamundo TV network, modeled after Miami's One Biscayne Tower. In the Extended Look, Jason and Lucia enter it as private security.

locations.name: NINE1NINE
locations.description: A nightclub in Downtown Vice City.

locations.name: The Rusty Anchor
locations.description: A bar in Key Lento, Leonida Keys, seen in Rockstar's Leonida Keys screenshots.

locations.name: Delights
locations.description: A cabaret in Port Gellhorn, seen in Rockstar's Port Gellhorn screenshots.

locations.name: Evergreen Shopping Mall
locations.description: A shopping mall in Waning Sands, Leonard County.

locations.name: Pegassi Residences North Tower
locations.description: The north one of the two curved Pegassi Residences towers on Tequesta Retreat (Brickell Key), Vice City, which appear in Rockstar's Vice City screenshots.

locations.name: Pegassi Residences South Tower
locations.description: The south one of the two curved Pegassi Residences towers on Tequesta Retreat (Brickell Key), Vice City, which appear in Rockstar's Vice City screenshots.

locations.name: Jack of Hearts
locations.description: Boobie Ike's club in Crosstown, Vice City. Rockstar's line about him: it's all about heart, the Jack of Hearts.

locations.name: Vice City Ferris Wheel
locations.description: The Ferris wheel on the Downtown waterfront, next to the Sahara Arena. It goes without a name so far and is modeled after the Skyviews wheel at Miami's Bayside Marketplace.

locations.name: Stockyard Walls
locations.description: The murals of Stockyard, Vice City's answer to Miami's Wynwood. More than 50 real street artists made murals for GTA 6, some of them here.

locations.name: Naval Air Station
locations.description: The naval air station on Goose Key (Boca Chica Key), at the south western end of the Leonida Keys, with two crossing runways.

locations.name: Grassrivers
locations.description: The wild heart of Leonida: a vast swamp of mangroves and gators, with stranger and deadlier things hidden below the surface.

locations.name: Leonida Keys
locations.description: A chain of laid back tropical islands: casual dress, loaded bars and deck chairs, on the edge of some of the most beautiful and dangerous waters in America.

locations.name: Vice City Oceanarium

locations.name: Thrillbilly Mud Club
